title: Mixed device and string label array API handling in LinearDiscriminantAnalysis
answers: How do I support mixed device or namespace array API inputs in scikit-learn estimators?
Why does LinearDiscriminantAnalysis.fit crash when y is on a different device or has string labels?
How does the 'everything follows X' policy handle string labels with array API devices?
body:
Symptom: Fitting LinearDiscriminantAnalysis with array API inputs raises when y resides on a different device or namespace than X, or when y contains string labels.
Root cause: sklearn/discriminant_analysis.py:LinearDiscriminantAnalysis.fit did not align y to X's device or namespace, and array API standards cannot represent non-numeric string labels.
Fix pattern: Extract self.classes_ using unique_labels(y), encode y into integer codes with _encode, and transfer the codes to X's namespace and device using move_to before passing them to solvers.
Constraints: Applies to array-API-compliant estimators following the 'everything follows X' policy; self.classes_ must remain in y's original device/namespace.
applies: Array API input validation and device alignment in scikit-learn classification estimators.
